steps: Rinse the quinoa under cold water; peel and dice the onion; mince the garlic; trim and dice the zucchini into small cubes.
Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook for 3 minutes, until softened.
Add the lean ground beef; cook for 5 to 6 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the oregano and paprika; cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the zucchini, rinsed quinoa, crushed tomatoes, and unsalted vegetable broth; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then cover and reduce heat to low; cook for 15 minutes, until quinoa is tender and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and check that zucchini is fully soft before serving.
Yields about 6 cups · 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze in portions for up to 2 months.
